name: Group of Etrean Nobles
desc:
The Group of Etrean Nobles are an Etrean NPC. They are the collective Sachans of the [Etrean Royalists](faction:etrean_royalists), consisting of [Sachan Shisui Kobura](entity:sachan_shisui_kobura), [Sachan Yi Anako](entity:sachan_yi_anako), [Sachan Zaru Ganba](entity:sachan_zaru_ganba), and Sachan Choji Mofisu.

The four are in a heated argument after unable to decide a strategy on fighting [Dravik, The Rat King](entity:dravik_the_rat_king) and the Etrean Civil War as a whole, ultimately causing each Sachan and their clans to separate and go in their own ways.

Each Sachan in the scene are donned in their respective clan's armor.
